title: Shared-row consumer eligibility integrity filter
objective: Require weekly and relevance consumers to exclude quarantined, pre-floor, source-unbound or immutable-provenance-invalid rows from eligible, divergence and performance counts.

evidence.summary: Post-merge review found weekly and relevance consumers outside the original task scope still count rows without applying the full P0 eligibility and quarantine filter.
Follow-up repairs exact ETHBTC state and immutable row provenance within approved files, but explicitly routes consumer filtering as a separate task.
Runtime remains quarantined with zero eligible rows and no activation floor.

reproduction: Provide a controlled ledger containing one fully bound post-floor row and rows that are quarantined, pre-floor, source-unbound or immutable-provenance-invalid. Run weekly and relevance consumers and verify whether excluded rows enter eligible, divergence, maturity or performance counts.

positive: Only fully eligible post-floor rows enter weekly and relevance metrics.
Zero eligible rows remains COLLECTING and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Filtering is deterministic and shared between both consumers.
negative: Quarantined, pre-floor, unbound or provenance-invalid rows never affect metrics.
No existing row is activated or backdated.
No market, portfolio or automatic-promotion semantics change.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already applies one fail-closed eligibility predicate in both consumers and the adversarial fixture passes.
stop_condition: Stop if the repair requires changing research decisions, activation floors or market semantics.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if eligibility policy itself is ambiguous or requires a new canonical contract.
rollback_plan: Revert only consumer-side filtering and tests. Preserve ledgers and quarantine state.
